summary: STAK Inc. filed a 6-K report announcing a non-binding MOU to form a majority-owned U.S. subsidiary for modular gas-to-electricity power systems for AI data centers. No specific deal terms (price, premium, close date) were disclosed. The subsidiary is not yet formed, remains subject to definitive agreements, and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation category. This is a routine corporate development update, not a material special situation event.
